description: Larger held-out smoke corpus for noisy conversational speech and real mobile UI screenshots. Downloaded artifacts stay outside the repository; this file records reproducible selection and provenance.

audio.provenance: AMI Meeting Corpus distant-microphone (SDM) test utterances served by the Hugging Face datasets server.
audio.citation: Carletta et al., The AMI Meeting Corpus: A Pre-Announcement (2005).

visual.provenance: Screen2Words test screenshots and crowd-authored screen summaries served by the Hugging Face datasets server.
visual.citation: Wang et al., Screen2Words: Automatic Mobile UI Summarization with Multimodal Learning (2021).
